classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In the main loop each iteration calls probe.read_staged on the class_a path inline and times it as 'gated' stall before probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s), so the rank itself waits on this read with no other rank held at a barrier.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b items are read once each by the separate _prefetch process feeding a bounded queue while the main loop computes, so the read is overlapped rather than waited on, and only the prefetching process is involved.
